description: Delete a collection and every face, selfie and photo record in it. By default this is a SOFT delete: the collection is hidden at once and purged after a 7-day grace period, and restore_collection undoes it until then. immediate=true starts the purge now and cannot be undone. compliance=true records an audited erasure (GDPR/BIPA) and cannot be restored. Confirm with the user before calling this. Free.

collection_id.description: Collection id, e.g. an event or album id. Any text except '/', '\', '.' and '..'.

compliance.description: Audited legal erasure. Irreversible and never restorable.

confirm_erase.description: Set true once the user has confirmed they want to erase a collection that still holds faces. When the API answers 409 confirmation_required, ask the user and retry with this.

immediate.description: Purge now instead of after the grace period. Irreversible.

name: delete_collection
title: Delete a collection
